name: Maru
description: Splits time between Harvey's clinic and gadgets in the mountain lab. Batteries, gold bars, and rare minerals impress her most.

seo.title: Maru — Inventor & Nurse
seo.description: Splits time between Harvey's clinic and gadgets in the mountain lab. Batteries, gold bars, and rare minerals impress her most.

stardew.intro: Demetrius and Robin's daughter, Harvey's nurse, and tinkerer extraordinaire. Brilliant, busy, and a little competitive with Sebastian.

heartEvents.title: Telescope night
heartEvents.summary: Visit the mountain at night while she stargazes with her telescope.

heartEvents.title: Hospital visit
heartEvents.summary: She treats a patient at the clinic and shows her competent, caring side.

heartEvents.title: Gadget test
heartEvents.summary: She asks you to test a homemade device — do not flinch when it sparks.

heartEvents.title: Confession on the hill
heartEvents.summary: On the mountain she admits she has been thinking about you a lot.

heartEvents.title: Planetarium kiss
heartEvents.summary: Under the stars at her telescope, she kisses you.

relationships.name: Harvey
relationships.note: Works as his nurse — professional and fond of her boss.

relationships.name: Sebastian
relationships.note: Step-siblings who share a roof but not much overlap in daily life.

trivia: Battery packs from lightning rods are a top-tier loved gift once your farm scales up.
